header: Extras you can add to any plan
subheader: Add or cancel each one on its own. They are never bundled into a bigger plan.
lead: Each extra is billed per practice per month, unless the line says otherwise. You can cancel any extra at the end of a billing period.
note: Prices are per practice per month and exclude VAT. A cancelled add-on ends with the billing period, with no partial refund.

addons.title: Online booking
addons.text: Patients book free slots on your website, within the rules you set for each treatment type.

addons.title: Patient app with exercise plans
addons.text: Exercise plans, videos and home exercise reminders on the patient's own phone.

addons.title: Additional treatment address
addons.text: One more address in the same appointment book, with its own rooms, opening hours and practitioners.

addons.title: Printed recall letters
addons.text: Base fee for the print service. Each letter costs €0.95, including postage.

addons.title: Waiting-list automation
addons.text: Cancelled slots are offered to the waiting list by SMS, in the order you set. Nobody has to make calls.

addons.title: Document storage, 50 GB
addons.text: Cheaper than the per-GB rate once you store more than about 35 GB.

addons.title: Card-terminal connection
addons.text: Patients pay at the terminal, and Talbrunn marks the invoice as paid. Nobody retypes anything.

addons.title: Second data location
addons.text: A second data centre in Austria keeps a live copy. For practices whose contracts require business continuity.
